seed_data.title: Sorrento - Breathable Nail Polish

recall.retrieval_summary: This creamy, light yellow is inspired by the "lemon town" of Italy, Sorrento. Located in Naples and on the stunning Amalfi coast, the lemons found here have been famous for centuries and are known for their flavor and healthy properties.
recall.retrieval_body:
This creamy, light yellow is inspired by the "lemon town" of Italy, Sorrento. Located in Naples and on the stunning Amalfi coast, the lemons found here have been famous for centuries and are known for their flavor and healthy properties. In excavations of Pompeii, the iconic Sorrento lemons are seen in mosaic artwork of that period. Sorrento is best described as a light, creamy yellow breathable nail polish. Sorrento is more yellow than Zanzibar and has no shimmer.

How long before I get my order? You can expect to have your package in 4-7 business days once shipped in the United States & Canada.

You can expect to have your package in 4-7 business days once shipped in the United States & Canada.

Where are 786 polishes made? 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are manufactured and produced in the United States.

786 Cosmetics nail polishes are manufactured and produced in the United States.

How can I ensure water permeability? To ensure water permeability, we suggest using no more than two thin coats of 786 Cosmetics nail polish. This can be one coat of color and one coat of a top coat, or two coats of color. We make our halal nail polishes highly pigmented so you won't need to apply more than one coat of nail polish for most of our colors.

To ensure water permeability, we suggest using no more than two thin coats of 786 Cosmetics nail polish. This can be one coat of color and one coat of a top coat, or two coats of color. We make our halal nail polishes highly pigmented so you won't need to apply more than one coat of nail polish for most of our colors.

How are 786 polishes Halal? 786 Cosmetics has worked with Islamic scholars to understand the requirements for halal nail polish. For more information please visit the How It Works page. There are two qualities that make 786 Cosmetics halal. 786 Cosmetics products contain no animal products or byproducts and no prohibited alcohol. 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are water permeable – this means it can be worn during wudu. When the nails are rubbed, water permeates the nail polish making your wudu valid.
